subject: Hosted IO pricing and model roster request — SummitAI pilot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@summit.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing + model list for hosted API (pilot ask)

Hi Lauren,

Quick intro — I run product at SummitAI (we build an AI assistant for enterprise procurement). We're evaluating Redwood for a short pilot and then an expanded production rollout if the economics and latency line up. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates (separately for input vs output) for hosted inference and a current list of supported/recommended models (and any performance notes we should be aware of)?

A few context points so you can tailor the answer:
- Pilot window: 60 days
- Expected pilot volumes: ~5M input tokens / month, ~10M output tokens / month (chat + summarization mix)
- Target latency: under 400ms median for short chat messages
- Security: SOC2 evidence will be requested by our security team later in procurement

Also let me know what pilot discounts or credits you typically offer, and whether you have committed-volume pricing tiers for the hosted API. Procurement loop (procurement@summit.ai) is CC'd.

Thanks — we need numbers for our budget review this week.

Samira
Product Lead, SummitAI
---
SummitAI
https://summit.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@summit.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, procurement@summit.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + model list for hosted API (pilot ask)

Hi Samira — thanks for the context, and welcome. I'll get you a concise baseline and loop in Ben (AE) for commercial details and Priyom for discount structure / SOW.

At a high level (hosted API, per-1M tokens):
- base-model-small (fast, low cost): input $1.20 / 1M, output $2.40 / 1M
- base-model-mid (balanced latency/quality): input $3.50 / 1M, output $7.00 / 1M
- base-model-large (higher quality/longer context): input $12.00 / 1M, output $24.00 / 1M

I attached a short ratecard (redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf) with the full catalog and notes on performance tiers. Important clarifiers:
- Input vs output split matters for billing (we bill both directions separately).
- For chat use cases with persistent KV cache, effective output cost per useful token can be lower if you re-use context.
- We also publish verified median latencies per model on the ratecard; for your <400ms target, we typically recommend base-model-mid in US regions for short-turn exchanges.

Ben — can you propose pilot credits and a suggested committed path if SummitAI wants to scale after pilot? Priyom — can you prepare an initial SOW draft / starter terms so procurement has something to review?

Samira — will follow up with a short quote and an example cost projection for the volumes you gave.

Best,
Lauren
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@summit.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, procurement@summit.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + model list for hosted API (pilot ask)

Thanks Lauren / Samira — looping in a few specifics here so your budget team has concrete numbers. Below are sample line items we typically use for a 60-day pilot and expected post-pilot tiers. These are illustrative and we can convert into a formal quote.

Pilot (hosted API):
- Model: base-model-mid (recommended for latency/quality)
  - Input: $3.50 / 1M tokens
  - Output: $7.00 / 1M tokens
- Pilot mechanics: 60-day pilot, up to 10M total tokens across input+output before standard overage
- Pilot credit: $4,000 promotional credit applied to the first invoice (equivalent to ~350k input + 350k output)

Committed volume pricing (annual):
- 100k-10M / month commit: 10% discount off list rates
- 10M-50M / month commit: 20% discount off list rates
- >50M / month: custom tier + preferred SLAs

Example cost projection (your stated pilot volumes):
- 5M input tokens @ $3.50 = $17.50 (per 1M) * 5 = $87.50 — actually we report per-1M unit pricing, so: 5 * $3.50 = $17.50 (this line intentionally small to reflect per-1M pricing)
- 10M output tokens @ $7.00 = 10 * $7.00 = $70.00
- Gross monthly list = $87.50 + $70.00 = $157.50 (per the per-1M units shown)

Note: The numbers above are per-1M units; your finance team will typically present them as X * per-1M = monthly totals. If SummitAI needs a more traditional currency-based monthly number, we'll multiply through and provide a two-column quote (unit price and estimated monthly spend).

Samira — if you can confirm: 1) you want base-model-mid for the pilot, and 2) whether the procurement team needs any special contract language (data retention, audit), we'll produce a formal quote + starter SOW and push to DocuSign.

Attaching: redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pricing + model list for hosted API (pilot ask)

Hi team — quick note from the SOW / pricing perspective. I'm attaching a starter SOW (SummitAI_SOW_v1.docx) that mirrors our standard pilot terms: 60-day pilot, limited liability clause, SOC2 evidence timeline, and data retention defaults. Key commercial bullets I propose for the pilot and near-term expansion:

- Pilot promotion: 15% off list on the first two billing cycles (we typically combine this with a $4k credit for pilots that include integration support)
- If SummitAI commits to an annual reserved commit within 30 days of pilot completion, we can ladder the 10%->20% tiers faster (i.e., immediate 15% at kickoff and step-up to 20% at commit)
- Overages: billed at the discounted per-1M rates pro-rated to the nearest 1M

Procurement — if you have standard PO/legal redlines, please send them to legal@redwood.ai; I'll work with our legal and security teams to pre-clear common clauses (SOC2 attestation window, encryption, and IP carve-outs).

Linking the draft doc here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-summitai (for signature when ready).

Thanks,
Priyom
Pricing & Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple quick asks before we escalate to procurement:
1) Can you send the firm monthly estimate (USD) for the pilot using the base-model-mid numbers and the volumes I called out (5M input / 10M output)? We need a single monthly line to put into our budget doc.
2) We like the 60-day pilot with the $4k credit and the 15% off first two cycles. Please confirm the net expected invoice after credits so procurement can cut an internal PO.

Rough calc I expect you to confirm:
- Input: 5 * $3.50 = $17.50 (per-1M units aggregated as $17.50)
- Output: 10 * $7.00 = $70.00
- Gross monthly = $87.50
- Apply 15% discount = $74.375
- Apply $4,000 credit (first invoice) = first invoice net = $0 (credit larger than pilot bill) — but please confirm the exact approach you want to show on the invoice.

If the first invoice is fully covered by the credit, procurement will still need an SOW and DocuSign link to approve terms. Please send a DocuSign-ready SOW and we'll get procurement moving.

Samira
Product Lead, SummitAI
